VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 58 tests pass and describes the fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 58 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish factual claims about test results without supporting documentation.
